test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: SIDBI, in November 2024, signed a MoU with which of the following for strengthening the collaboration to support MSMEs through capacity building, credit facilities, and knowledge-sharing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peenya Industries Association**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) signed a MoU with Peenya Industries Association in November 2024.
 
• The collaboration aims to support Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) through capacity building, credit facilities, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
 
• Peenya Industries Association is one of the largest industrial associations in India, representing the interests of MSMEs in the Peenya Industrial Area in Bengaluru.
 
• This partnership will focus on enhancing the competitiveness and growth of MSMEs by providing them with the necessary resources and support.
 
• The MoU is part of SIDBI's ongoing efforts to strengthen the MSME ecosystem in India, which is a critical sector for economic development and job creation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)**

 
 
• SIDBI was established on April 2, 1990, under an Act of the Indian Parliament.
 
• It is the principal financial institution for the promotion, financing, and development of MSMEs in India.
 
• SIDBI provides various financial products and services to MSMEs, including term loans, working capital loans, and equity support.
 
• SIDBI also engages in policy advocacy and development initiatives to create a conducive environment for MSMEs.
 
 
 
• **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)**
 
 
• MSMEs are classified based on their investment in plant and machinery or equipment and annual turnover.
 
• MSMEs play a crucial role in the Indian economy, contributing significantly to GDP, exports, and employment.
 
• They are often considered the backbone of the Indian economy due to their extensive presence across sectors and geographies.
 
• The Indian government has implemented various schemes and policies to support the growth and development of MSMEs.
 
 
 
• **Peenya Industrial Area**
 
 
• Located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, Peenya Industrial Area is one of the oldest and largest industrial areas in India.
 
• It houses a diverse range of industries, including manufacturing, engineering, electronics, and information technology.
 
• Peenya Industries Association represents the interests of businesses operating in this industrial area.
 
• The association works towards addressing the challenges faced by industries and facilitating their growth and development.
 
 
 
• **Capacity Building**
 
 
• Capacity building refers to the process of developing and strengthening the skills, abilities, and resources of organizations and individuals.
 
• It is essential for enhancing the efficiency, effectiveness, and sustainability of organizations, particularly in the MSME sector.
 
• Capacity building can include training programs, workshops, technical assistance, and mentoring.
 
• It aims to improve the overall performance and competitiveness of MSMEs, enabling them to adapt to changing market conditions and technological advancements.
